summary: The scene lands its two closing procedural strokes and the load-bearing image of the two file covers side by side, but a named walk-on with no canon entry, an impossible hand-off through a doorway, a paragraph that abstracts away its own event, and a self-contradicting timeline sentence keep it from working as written.

issues.unit: P5: "Gemeindeschreiber Anton Hürlimann, der am Fenster saß"
issues.fix_hint: Drop the name; keep him unnamed as 'der Gemeindeschreiber am Fenster'.

issues.unit: P8: "Vom Flur aus reichte Feuz ihm die Mappe noch einmal über den"
issues.fix_hint: Cut this sentence: Feuz already put on his coat and left in P7, so he cannot reach the folder back over the desk from the hallway.
Cut this sentence and the one before it; give the actual words Berta and Stettler exchanged about the dead man instead of naming the tension and the fact that they spoke.

issues.unit: P15: "Gleich nach Mittag hatte er das Amtszimmer verlassen und war nicht zurückgekehrt."
issues.fix_hint: Cut this sentence; it directly contradicts 'Er blieb bis zum Abend im Amtszimmer' in the same paragraph and also undercuts Berta's afternoon visit in P9.
